<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>

    <rect x="329" y="14" width="3" height="13" rx="1" fill="#0F172A"/>
    <rect x="334" y="11" width="3" height="16" rx="1" fill="#0F172A"/>

    <circle cx="353" cy="23" r="4" fill="#0F172A"/>
    <line x1="350" y1="18" x2="356" y2="18" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <rect x="385" y="16" width="2" height="6" rx="1" fill="#0F172A"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="48,74 39,82 48,90" fill="none" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="67" y="89" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#0F172A">Edit Profile</text>
    <line x1="31" y1="111" x2="359" y2="111" stroke="#F1F5F9" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Profile photo -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="161" r="44" fill="#DCF0F9" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="4"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="151" r="13" fill="#52B6DF"/>

  <!-- Form -->
  <g>
    <text x="31" y="284" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#0F172A">Email address</text>
    <rect x="31" y="294" width="328" height="49" rx="10" fill="#F1F5F966" stroke="#F1F5F9" stroke-width="1"/>

    <text x="31" y="371" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#0F172A">Date of birth</text>
    <rect x="31" y="381" width="328" height="49" rx="10" fill="#F1F5F966" stroke="#F1F5F9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="47" y="412" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#0F172A">14 September 1991</text>
    <rect x="333" y="397" width="14" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="333" y1="402" x2="347" y2="402" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="394" x2="336" y2="399" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="344" y1="394" x2="344" y2="399" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <rect x="31" y="468" width="328" height="49" rx="10" fill="#F1F5F966" stroke="#F1F5F9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="47" y="499" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#0F172A">+1 415 555 0186</text>
    <text x="31" y="542" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">Keep your contact details up to date.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Primary action -->
  <g>
    <rect x="31" y="570" width="328" height="56" rx="10" fill="#52B6DF" opacity="0.14"/>
    <rect x="31" y="568" width="328" height="56" rx="10" fill="#52B6DF"/>
    <text x="195" y="603" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Update Profile</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Security note -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="47" cy="661" r="10" fill="#DCF0F9"/>
    <rect x="43" y="658" width="8" height="7" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#316D86" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <polyline points="45,658 45,655 49,655 49,658" fill="none" stroke="#316D86" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="66" y="666" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">Your information is securely stored.</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="772" width="390" height="72" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <text x="129" y="825" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#64748B">My Cars</text>

    <!-- Service -->
    <circle cx="195" cy="796" r="10" fill="#DCF0F9"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="790" x2="195" y2="802" stroke="#316D86" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="189" y1="796" x2="201" y2="796" stroke="#316D86" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="195" y="825" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#316D86">Service</text>

    <!-- Community -->
    <circle cx="268" cy="792" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="281" cy="792" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="274.5" cy="804" rx="11" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="275" y="825" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#64748B">Community</text>

    <!-- More -->
    <circle cx="342" cy="790" r="2" fill="#64748B"/>
    <circle cx="342" cy="797" r="2" fill="#64748B"/>
    <circle cx="342" cy="804" r="2" fill="#64748B"/>
    <text x="342" y="825" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#64748B">More</text>
  </g>
</svg>
